slides.headline: Your Coffee Cash Funds Starbucks
slides.subheadline: The promise: easier shopping, rewards, balances without expiration.

production.deckRules: Apply throughout: 64px condensed headlines, 32px minimum body copy, monospace kickers with square accent dots, tabular numerals, 64px safe margins, 1px hairlines, 0px corners. No shadows, pills, thick accent borders, progress bars, clipart, arrows, conduits, or simulated text. Production fields and svgBlueprint are non-rendered instructions. Citations remain attached to supported copy. Illustrations are conceptual, never quantitative unless explicitly scaled.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 650" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Allocate 50% of the canvas to a financial specimen elevation. On #0D0E12, place an imposing #161820 stored-value-card rectangle at x=146,y=70,width=660,height=430, with a 1px #F1F3F9 outline. Draw one #FF4D00 magnetic-stripe hairline across y=168. Separate a narrow geometric section beneath the card at y=526, suggesting an exposed accounting layer rather than missing funds. Add four short corner registration ticks and a single vertical dimension rule with perpendicular terminals. Keep all geometry within bounds. No fabricated coordinates or account numbers. Above the illustration, set the supplied headline at 64px over three deliberate lines; below it, a 1px divider. Finish with the fee telemetry and publication metadata in a clean footer ledger.

slides.headline: Convenience Keeps Your Cash Committed
slides.subheadline: Automatic reload replenishes balances on your chosen trigger.

items.title: CANCELLATION WINDOW
items.body: Cancel **at least 24 hours before** scheduled auto-reload.

items.title: COMPLETED LOADS
items.body: **Cannot reverse**; legal and contractual refund exceptions remain.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 420" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Continue the #0D0E12 paper field. Draw two offset stored-value-card outlines behind the composition, one at x=40,y=32,width=648,height=300 and another at x=112,y=82,width=648,height=300. Give each exactly one magnetic-stripe hairline; use muted ink for the rear specimen and #FF4D00 for the exposed foreground edge. Overlay a dominant #161820 editorial panel at x=0,y=54,width=600,height=298 and a smaller ledger panel at x=628,y=164,width=324,height=188. Both have 1px borders and square corners. Place cancellation copy in the hero panel and completed-load copy in the secondary panel. Use generous empty space, not decorative text lines. The offset silhouettes suggest replenishment without implying a measured quantity or showing a process diagram.

slides.headline: That Balance Isn't Just Cards
slides.subheadline: September 28, 2025: cards and loyalty, not isolated cash.

items.title: BROADER CAPTION
items.body: **$1,840.6 million** combines cards with current deferred revenue.

items.title: NESTLÉ INCLUDED
items.body: **$177.0 million** represents current Nestlé deferred revenue.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 440" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Place the exact $1,751.7 numeral above the illustration at 104px, tabular and #FF4D00, with its uppercase monospace million-unit label immediately beneath. Within the SVG, construct two detached accounting strata: an upper outlined slab spanning x=76..876,y=54..180, and a lower #161820 slab spanning x=76..876,y=254..380. A clean 74px void separates them. Give the upper slab a short orange vertical incision at x=646; leave the lower slab intact. Add one capped dimension rule along x=34. These are conceptual accounting categories, not proportional bars or an additive reconciliation. Set the two explanatory items beneath the illustration as open typographic notes separated by one hairline, not cards. Never depict the combined liability as a cash reserve.

slides.headline: Prepayment Becomes Revenue In Stages
slides.subheadline: Redemption obligations and unclaimed-property rules constrain the mechanism.

items.title: CASH FIRST
items.body: Customers **prepay**; Starbucks records a redemption obligation.

items.title: PURCHASE FULFILLED
items.body: Redemptions **release deferred revenue** into reported sales.

items.title: NONREDEMPTION ESTIMATED
items.body: **Estimated nonredemption** becomes revenue proportionally with redemptions.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 480" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Draw one continuous 1px ink spine at x=52 from y=32 to y=448. Place 10px square milestone markers centered at y=76,240,404; the final square is #FF4D00, the others ink. Align monospace tags at x=90 and editorial copy at x=158, with identical baselines and ample vertical separation. In the far-right background, draw three isolated financial cross-sections at x=780..920: a closed card edge, an exposed two-layer liability section, and a narrow orange accounting slice. These are specimen elevations, not connected nodes. No arrows or branching lines. The spine communicates narrative order only, not elapsed time, expiration, or a forfeiture countdown.

slides.headline: The Filing Reveals Breakage Revenue
slides.subheadline: Revenue, not interest income or pure net profit.

items.title: COMPANY OPERATED
items.body: **$200.4 million** came from company-operated store breakage.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 448 370" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Divide the content field vertically 50/50 with a 1px hairline and a 40px gutter. The left half holds a uniformly scaled architectural section: a #161820 balance-sheet monolith at x=54,y=30,width=340,height=300, outlined in ink. Incise a narrow #FF4D00 vertical reveal at x=296, and detach one outlined rectangular section at x=318,y=98,width=76,height=144. Use capped dimension marks and four corner registration ticks only. This abstract specimen is not a chart and must not imply component proportions. The right half carries the two 1px-bordered ledger cards and the exact calculated total underneath. Keep the date visible in the footer; never label the total profit or interest.

slides.headline: Starbucks Benefits Before You Spend

items.title: FINANCING COST
items.body: Starbucks receives prepayment; customers earn **no interest**.

items.title: DEPOSIT INSURANCE
items.body: Your prepaid balance carries **no FDIC insurance**.

items.title: BREAKAGE REVENUE
items.body: Starbucks recognizes **estimated nonredemption** as additional revenue.

slides.svgBlueprint: viewBox="0 0 952 420" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet". Use exactly three ledger rows, the explicit structural exception to the deck's two-card limit. Draw 1px horizontal rules at y=0,140,280,420, with no filled row containers. Set indexes in a 70px monospace column, two-word labels and findings in the central column, and numerical metrics right-aligned at x=936. Metric units sit directly below their numbers. Behind the central column, place a very subdued vault-section contour: a single squared outer frame with one inset structural rectangle and one offset card edge, all at low ink opacity. No ornamental horizontal strokes resembling text. Orange is restricted to the numerical metrics and three tiny square index markers. Preserve clear separation between interest, insurance, and revenue; they are not comparable quantities.

slides.headline: Retail Prepayment, Not A Bank
slides.subheadline: Starbucks benefits from early cash and estimated nonredemption.​

items.title: THE ADVANTAGE
items.body: **Interest-free customer financing**, then revenue from estimated nonredemption.​

items.title: YOUR LIMIT
items.body: **Cash refunds generally restricted**; legal and contractual exceptions.

Behind them, show one intact stored-value-card perimeter spanning x=106..846,y=48..390, with a single #FF4D00 stripe exposed in the gutter. Add two disconnected balance-sheet strata beneath the perimeter, one ink and one orange; no connectors, arrows, bank facade, or implied reserve ratio.
